lines.beaver: 오늘 법원에 가서 재판을 보고 왔어요.
lines.beaver_en: I went to the court today and watched the trial.
lines.beaver_roman: Oneul beobwone gaseo jaepaneul bogo wasseoyo.
lines.en: Really? The corruption case trial, right?

lines.beaver: 네, 회사 대표가 돈을 빼돌린 사건이에요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, the case where the CEO embezzled money.
lines.beaver_roman: Ne, hoesa daepyoga doneul ppaedollin sakkeonieyo.
lines.en: That's illegal, so he has no choice but to be punished.

lines.beaver_en: I heard the prosecutors investigated thoroughly.
lines.learner: 증거가 많으면 처벌을 피할 수 없겠네요.
lines.en: If there's a lot of evidence, he won't be able to avoid punishment.
lines.roman: Jeunggeoga maneumyeon cheobeoreul pihal ssu eopgenneyo.

lines.beaver_en: Do you think he'll be detained?
lines.learner: 네, 구속될 수밖에 없을 것 같아요.
lines.en: Yes, I think he'll have to be detained.
lines.roman: Ne, gusokdoel ssubakke eopseul kkeot gatayo.

lines.beaver_en: His lawyer objected, citing Article 5 of the law.
lines.beaver_roman: Byeonhosaneun beomnyul je ojoreul deulmyeonseo bandaehaesseoyo.
lines.en: Article 5 won't easily clear him of the crime.
lines.roman: Je ojoroneun joereul beotgi eoryeoul kkeoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then will he be in prison for long?
lines.learner: 생각보다 짧을 수도 있지만 감옥엔 갈 거예요.
lines.en: It might be shorter than expected, but he'll go to prison.
lines.roman: Saenggakboda jjalbeul ssudo itjiman gamogen gal kkeoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Will the victims be able to get compensation?
lines.learner: 법원이 보상을 명령할 수밖에 없을 거예요.
lines.en: The court will have no choice but to order compensation.
lines.roman: Beobwoni bosangeul myeongnyeonghal ssubakke eopseul kkeoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: They say the verdict comes out next month.
lines.en: I hope the verdict is fair.

lines.beaver: 법과 재판에 대해 더 이야기해 볼래요?
lines.beaver_en: Shall we talk more about law and trials?
lines.beaver_roman: Beopgwa jaepane daehae deo iyagihae bollaeyo?
lines.learner: 좋아요. 이런 부정은 철저히 막아야 해요.
lines.en: Sure. This kind of corruption must be stopped thoroughly.
lines.roman: Joayo. Ireon bujeongeun cheoljeohi magaya haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Right. Let's talk again when the verdict is out.
lines.en: Yes, I'll be sure to check too. Take care.
